text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 18 · 齿轮与地图的航行室.
Environment:  An empty airship chart room with warm timber paneling, brass-framed round windows, a large table holding an unlabeled hand-drawn abstract map, compact orrery and navigation instruments, gentle exposed clockwork gears behind glass on one wall. Bright clouds visible outside, cream upholstery and pale brass patina, realistic crafted film set, no faces or figures.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 3 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Edit this room contact sheet. Preserve views A and B exactly. Remove inconsistent views C and D. Create a third view C that is a close architectural detail of the brass clock and adjacent bookcase on the room's RIGHT wall as already seen in B; keep round windows on its left. Make a clean three-panel landscape contact sheet A, B, C. Empty environment, no people, no new room.
